backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing access-controlled user profiles and a consultation request system with admin-only retrieval and clearing.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping product requirements to frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of various frontend files for reference and build planning.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based style sheet defining brand color tokens and light/dark mode variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting page metadata and loading the React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component rendering the HomePage.
frontend/src/components/ConsultationRequ: Modal dialog wrapper that displays the consultation request form.
Form component handling validation, submission to backend, and a success confirmation state.
frontend/src/components/sections/HomeSec: React sections for the homepage including Hero, How It Works, Technology & Systems, Services, Quality Control, Contractor Model, Trust callouts, and Franchise teaser.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer with company description, approach highlights, and a consultation request CTA.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Sticky header displaying branding and a CTA button to open the consultation request form.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on the user’s Internet Identity and refreshes related queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, including loading, login, logout, and identity management utilities.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exposes a mutation hook that submits consultation requests through the backend actor and invalidates related queries.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind layers and custom CSS variables for theming, including brand colors and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the homepage layout, sections, and consultation request dialog with open-state control.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using both query strings and hash routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling custom colors, animations, typography, and brand styling extensions.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, requirements, features, design direction, and image needs for the PropertyOps website.
